anomalies.observed: On the Power sheet (page 4), J7 and J8 pin 1 have no connection. Pin 2 is connected to +12V and pin 3 to the respective fan tach net; pin 4 is marked no-connect.
anomalies.expected: Fan header pin 1 should be connected to GND to provide the fan’s return path.

evidence.quote: Power sheet, page 4: J7/J8 pin 1 is an open stub; pin 2 connects to +12V and pin 3 to FAN_0_TACH / FAN_1_TACH.

anomalies.impact: A fan connected only through these headers has no board-provided ground return, so it may not run; its tach output may also lack a reliable ground reference.

parsed.summary: Both fan headers provide +12V and a tach connection but leave pin 1 open instead of providing the expected ground return. This can prevent connected fans from operating normally.
